name: dx-packaging
description: Operate Salesforce package post-install configuration, subscriber push upgrades, and the Move-to-2GP cutover: automate managed-package setup after installation, plan and schedule package push upgrades, monitor or abort package rollout jobs, and move converted 1GP managed packages to 2GP development. Use for package setup in subscriber orgs, controlled package upgrades across subscriber fleets, or finalizing a 1GP-to-2GP move.
